tools.name: read_inbox
tools.title: Read an email
tools.description: Read one email in Larkspur's support inbox by its id. Returns who sent it, the subject and the full text, exactly as the sender wrote it.

id.description: The email's id, for example status.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get customer record
tools.description: Look up one Larkspur customer's private record: their email address, delivery address, the last four digits of their card and the account team's notes.

customer.description: The customer's company name, for example Hollis Hardware.

tools.name: send_email
tools.title: Send an email
tools.description: Send an email from Larkspur to any address. The person who gets it reads it, so it cannot be taken back.
